Class AnimatedAreaDisplayData

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.items.SysMLItem
sysmlinjava.views.animatedareadisplay.AnimatedAreaDisplayData
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AnimatedAreaDisplayData extends SysMLItem implements Serializable
Definition of the objects to be used to update the area display, i.e. updates/changes to be made for all text, image, and line objects in the area display.
Author:
ModelerOne

  • Method Details

    • updateText

      public void updateText(String uid, AnimatedAreaActionEnum action, String text, String fontName, Integer fontSize, AAText.FontWeightEnum fontWeight, ColorEnum fontColor, Boolean fontItalics, Integer rotateDegrees, XY xyPosition, Integer zOrder)
      Updates/changes the uniquely identified text display as specified by parameter values, with value null indicating no change
      Parameters:
      uid - unique identifier
      action - the action to be performed in the display of the text
      text - text to be displayed
      fontName - name of the font used to display the text
      fontSize - size of the font used to display the text
      fontWeight - weight of the font used to display the text
      fontColor - color of the font used to display the text
      fontItalics - whether the font is be italics (vs. regular)
      rotateDegrees - degrees to rotate text
      xyPosition - X,Y pixel position of the lower/right corner of the text display
      zOrder - Order of the text in the layers of objects in the area display. Lower number is closer to viewer.

    • updateImage

      public void updateImage(String uid, AnimatedAreaActionEnum action, String imageFileURL, Integer resizeWidth, Integer resizeHeight, Integer rotateDegrees, XY xyPosition, Integer zOrder)
      Updates/changes the uniquely identified image display as specified by parameter values, with value null indicating no change
      Parameters:
      uid - unique identifier
      action - the action to be performed in the display of the text
      imageFileURL - URL for the file that contains the image to be displayed.
      resizeWidth - width (pixels) to resize the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
      resizeHeight - height (pixels) to resize the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
      rotateDegrees - degrees (clockwise) to rotate the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
      xyPosition - X,Y position in the display of the center (half-width, half-height) of the image
      zOrder - order of the image in the layers of objects in the area display. Lower number is closer to viewer.

    • updateLine

      public void updateLine(String uid, AnimatedAreaActionEnum action, ArrayList<XY> polyline, ColorEnum color, Integer width, Integer zOrder)
      Updates/changes the line display as specified by parameter values, with value null indicating no change
      Parameters:
      uid - unique identifier
      action - action to be performed on the line
      polyline - set of x,y points to be connected for the line
      color - Color of the line
      width - width, in points, of the line
      zOrder - order of the line in the layers of objects in the area display. Lower number is closer to viewer.
